shared_context: Four participants must select a travel insurance plan for a two-week overseas field course covering medical emergencies, trip cancellations, and lost belongings. Each plan must provide coverage valid in the destination country and include 24/7 emergency assistance.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project coordinator experienced in managing overseas field courses.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the group selects a plan with strong emergency support and solid coverage.

A.reason_for: High medical and trip cancellation coverage fits safety priorities.

B.reason_against: Lower trip cancellation coverage than preferred.

C.reason_against: Medical coverage may be insufficient for serious emergencies.

D.reason_for: Multilingual 24/7 emergency assistance and solid coverage match needs.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a finance officer focused on cost-effective solutions for group expenses.
personas.private_goal: Find a plan that balances cost with adequate coverage for emergencies.

A.reason_for: Strong coverage but premium is high.
A.reason_against: Cost may not justify benefits over mid-range plans.

B.reason_against: Trip cancellation coverage is lower than some options.

C.reason_against: Medical coverage may be too low for emergencies.

D.reason_for: Good coverage and emergency support worth the slightly higher premium.

personas.background: Zoe is a risk-averse researcher with a focus on minimizing financial exposure.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize affordability while meeting all minimum coverage requirements.

B.reason_for: Balanced coverage but still pricier than basic.
